title: Law to require rodent control during sewer construction work
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection and private sewer work permit applicants to hire two licensed exterminators to develop and carry out a rodent abatement plan before certain construction or sewer work begins. Weekly extermination services would be required until the work is completed, and adjacent property owners must get written notice at least 5 days before work starts describing the rodent control efforts. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
